LanguageData.SDS_ImplantHediffA.label: Super Dimensional Basic Chip
LanguageData.SDS_ImplantHediffA.description: An implanted super dimensional link chip (basic model). While on the same map as a super dimensional core, the colonist and attached mechanoids can access the stored stock at any time.
LanguageData.SDS_ImplantHediffB.label: Super Dimensional Advanced Chip
LanguageData.SDS_ImplantHediffB.description: An implanted super dimensional link chip (advanced model). As long as super dimensional storage is available, the colonist and attached mechanoids can access the stored stock across maps at any time.
